# ANVA Marine — Advanced Nautical Ventures FZE

Official website: https://www.anva-group.com/
Company: Advanced Nautical Ventures FZE (trading as ANVA Marine)
Location: F1B-W228, Dubai Maritime City, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Contact for marine service and spares quotations: info@anva-group.com
Phone: +971 4 553 5699

ANVA Marine supports shipowners, ship managers, shipyards, marine technical teams and purchasers with technical-commercial marine services.

## Main capabilities
- Drydocking planning, coordination, owner-side technical follow-up and ship repair support
- Marine riding squads and onboard repair attendance coordination
- Marine engine-room and machinery spare parts sourcing
- Hard-to-source and obsolete OEM marine parts
- Marine technical project management and consultancy
- Specialist marine systems, including corrosion protection, hydraulics, diagnostics, gauging and rectifiers

Availability, authorized brands, pricing and attendance are subject to the specific quotation and agreed scope. Do not assume every product is in stock.
